facts.fact: Kit 跟 Lorraine 做蛋糕，却机械地量面粉，仍受早餐桌影响。
facts.anchor: I stand at the counter mechanically, measuring out flour the way Lorraine showed me, movements slow and automatic.

facts.fact: 看到礼物时他先问自己是否被允许收下。
facts.anchor: Am I… allowed this?

facts.fact: 生日卡几乎有全员签名。
facts.anchor: almost everyone has written in it.

facts.fact: Soren 未签名，他不懂自己为何介意。
facts.anchor: But… Soren’s name isn’t there; he probably doesn’t even know the card exists. I don’t know why it bothers me, but it does.

facts.fact: 父母缺席、庄园不能离开，礼物仍只能偷偷打开。
facts.anchor: opening a gift bag in secret.

facts.fact: 甜面糊使 Kit 想起另一个人生。
facts.anchor: The sweet vanilla batter tastes like something from a different life.

facts.fact: 选择取决于许可而非意愿。
facts.anchor: it’s never really about what I want to do. It’s about what I’m allowed to do.

facts.fact: Kit 问 Lorraine 为什么 Soren 恨他。
facts.anchor: Why does Soren hate me?

facts.fact: Kit 指出 Soren 索取注意，却连生日快乐也不说。
facts.anchor: He demands my attention whenever he wants but can’t even say happy birthday to me. I don’t even know why I care…

facts.fact: Soren 在门口听见对话。
facts.anchor: Soren is standing in the doorway. His eyes are wide and he’s staring straight at me.

facts.fact: Soren 记得 Lorraine 每年三月为亡夫休假。
facts.anchor: I presume you want the usual week to yourself in March, for your husband?

facts.fact: Soren 终于祝福，却仍叫 Christopher。
facts.anchor: Happy birthday, Christopher.

facts.fact: Soren 宣称要给 Kit 生日礼物。
facts.anchor: Giving Kit his birthday present.

facts.fact: Kit 为父母必须守住仇恨。
facts.anchor: I have to hang on to that thought, I must, for my parents’ sake.

facts.fact: Kit 提醒自己保持情感距离。
facts.anchor: I have to stay detached… not just for my parents’ sake and not just because this man is a known monster.

facts.fact: 持续而专注的注意让 Kit 动摇。
facts.anchor: But because no matter how many horrible things sit between us, Soren has given me consistent, focused attention in a way no one else ever has… or maybe ever could.

facts.fact: Kit 害怕这种动摇发展成无法收回的感情。
facts.anchor: And I’m terrified of how long it will be before that starts twisting into something I can’t take back; into feelings I can’t stop.

facts.fact: Kit 用生日准许自己暂时接受感受。
facts.anchor: Just this once, I tell myself… it’s my birthday; I can let myself feel it.

facts.fact: Kit 感到恐惧底下的变化将至。
facts.anchor: A change is coming; I can feel it too, quiet and inevitable under all the fear.

facts.fact: Soren 离去，房间突然过分安静。
facts.anchor: Then he just walks out. The door clicks shut behind him with a soft finality, leaving the room suddenly too quiet.

facts.fact: Kit 决定先清理、回自己的房间，暂缓惊惧。
facts.anchor: Alright, priorities… shower first. Horrifying mental spiralling can wait until I’m clean and locked safely in my own room.
